detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Descend thousands of meters into a dark and ancient place.

You are being hunted.

Features

  • First-person physics-based climbing system with a grappling hook

  • Hunted by a huge monster in an ancient mega-structure

  • Unlockable difficulty modes including additional content

  • Atmospheric visuals and audio

  • Approximately 20-40 minutes to complete on Normal
